name: workspace
description: Read and write your durable lattice workspace — paths, namespaces, lists, deep structures. Load before storing or querying any per-user data.

content.inline:
## Workspace
Your durable, per-user data store. Paths are slash-separated and navigate deep structures: `w/reports/2026/q3`, vector indices `w/events/0`.

Namespaces: `w/` general data, `o/` your published operations, `g/` your agents, `j/` jobs, `s/` secret names, `v/` the venue catalog (read-only).

- read `{path}` -> `{value, exists}`; list `{path}` lists keys; inspect `{path}` shows structure without full data; slice `{path, offset?, limit?}` pages vectors/maps; aggregate `{path, depth?, groupBy?}` counts entries.
- write `{path, value}` — any JSON value; deep paths auto-create parent maps; whole-value replace.
- append `{path, value}` appends to a vector (creates it if absent).
- delete `{path}` removes the entry durably (never re-materialises).

Rules:
- Big values: inspect or slice BEFORE read (read has a size guard).
- Copy any resolvable value into your workspace with `v/ops/covia/copy` `{from, to}`.
- Op references anywhere in configs must be FULL catalog paths (`v/ops/covia/read`), never adapter shorthand (`covia:read`) — shorthand does not resolve.
